title: Shelly’s new smart valve shuts off your home’s water before a leak becomes a flood

content.summary: After releasing a $28 leak sensor earlier this year that conveniently runs off a battery for two years, Shelly is announcing an accompanying smart valve you can install on your home's main water line to automatically turn off the flow when one of those sensors detects a problem. The Shelly Neo Smart Water Valve is available now through the company's online store for $499.99, plus the cost of installation if you don't trust your plumbing skills. It's not a cheap solution, but it's cheaper than the fallout of a leak turning into a disaster.
